about.title: ABOUT ME
about.bio:
I AM A BRAZILIAN DANCER, CHOREOGRAPHER AND TEACHER WHOSE JOURNEY BEGAN AT THE AGE OF SIX, MARKED BY RESILIENCE, CURIOSITY AND A DEEP CONNECTION WITH MOVEMENT. AS A TRANS MAN, DANCE BECAME THE MEDIUM THROUGH WHICH I INHABIT MY BODY, EXPLORE MY IDENTITY AND MOVE BETWEEN MULTIPLE WORLDS. AS A CREATOR, I DEVELOP ORIGINAL SOLOS IN WHICH I ACT AS AUTHOR, CHOREOGRAPHER AND DIRECTOR — PIECES THAT EXPLORE SINGULAR BODILY NARRATIVES AND HAVE BEEN PRESENTED AT NATIONAL AND INTERNATIONAL FESTIVALS. AS A TEACHER, I HAVE LED WORKSHOPS AT PUBLIC UNIVERSITIES, DANCE COMPANIES AND CULTURAL SPACES IN BRAZIL, WITH SOMATIC RESEARCH AND BODY AWARENESS AS THE CORE OF MY PEDAGOGICAL PRACTICE.

MY TRAINING AT BALLET JOVEM MINAS GERAIS EXPOSED ME TO DIVERSE CHOREOGRAPHIC VOICES, TEACHING ME THAT TECHNIQUE IS NOT ONLY PRECISION, BUT AWARENESS, ADAPTABILITY AND PRESENCE IN MULTIPLE MOVEMENT LANGUAGES. I GREW UP IN THE BRAZILIAN DANCE SCENE, WHERE RESOURCES ARE LIMITED: I LEARNED TO INVENT, ADAPT AND EMBRACE MULTIPLICITY IN CREATION. I REPRESENTED THE CONTEMPORARY DANCE OF MY REGION AT THE LYON DANCE BIENNALE. BEYOND THE STUDIO, PRACTICES SUCH AS CAPOEIRA, URBAN DANCE, AFRO-BRAZILIAN DANCE AND FLOORWORK HAVE EXPANDED MY PHYSICAL AND IMAGINATIVE REPERTOIRE. I BRING ENERGY, IMAGINATION AND A STRONG STAGE PRESENCE — COMMITTED TO CONTRIBUTING MY VOICE, CULTURE AND EXPERIENCE TO PROCESSES THAT VALUE INDIVIDUALITY, DEPTH AND CREATIVE EXPLORATION.

works.title: Gerúndio
works.description: Original solo of own creation. Concept, choreography, direction and performance: Heleno Carneiro. The piece explores the body in a gerund state — in perpetual becoming, between action and process. Presented at national and international contemporary dance festivals, including the 21st Lyon Dance Biennale (2025) as a representative of the Brazilian Young Creators Delegation.

works.title: Pulso
works.description: Original solo of own creation. Concept, choreography, direction and performance: Heleno Carneiro. A research into pulse as an organizing principle of movement — between the body's inner rhythm and time shared with the other.

works.title: Bambo
works.description: Street dance piece produced by the Franco-Brazilian dance company Ananda. Artistic direction and choreography: Heleno Carneiro. The work dialogues with the legacy of bamboo as a symbol of flexibility and resistance in Afro-Brazilian cultures.

works.title: Defesa
works.description: Dance-theater piece. Movement direction: Heleno Carneiro. An exploration of the mechanisms of protection, resistance and openness that we inhabit daily — the body as a field of negotiation between vulnerability and strength.

teaching.title: TEACHING
teaching.description: Pedagogical practice centered on somatic research, body awareness and the expansion of the movement repertoire. The workshop "Corpo 360°" proposes a three-dimensional exploration of the body — integrating floorwork, weight dynamics, contact and improvisation as tools for creation and self-knowledge.
